name: Felsőszentiván (Hungary)
description: Dark blue field with a large white lozenge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőszentiván (a shield of blue, red and green with a saint and a lion, with a helm, red and blue mantling and a scroll) below the name FELSŐSZENTIVÁN in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Felsőszentiván arms with helm, mantling and scroll
